analysis: ChargePoint reported Q2 FY27 results (8-K filed 9/2/26) with revenue up 18% YoY to $116.1M, beating the high end of guidance, alongside a significant improvement in adjusted EBITDA loss (to $4.8M from $22.1M YoY) and record non-GAAP gross margin of 38%. This is a growth name showing accelerating revenue growth plus a structural improvement in profitability trajectory (narrowing losses, cost discipline), which is a meaningful positive catalyst relative to its small $134M market cap. While not a guidance raise explicitly cited here, the beat-and-improve combination across revenue and margins qualifies as a strong catalyst rather than routine.
